channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: Latest: How is France’s high-speed internet rollout going?
item.description: The rollout of high-speed fibre internet across France enters a new phase this year as more of the old copper ADSL connections will be switched off - so how well served are French towns and cities when it comes to internet speeds?

item.title: What to do and where to go in France in Spring 2026
item.description: It’s cold and a bit dank outside right now, but Spring really isn’t that far away, so here’s what’s coming up in France as the days get longer, the sky bluer, and the sun warmer.

item.title: Train tickets go on sale for France's May 2026 holiday weekends
item.description: French rail operator SNCF has opened ticket sales for the Easter holidays and the long 'pont' weekends in May.

item.title: French Senate adopts bill to return colonial-era art
item.description: French senators adopted a bill on Wednesday to simplify the return of artworks looted during the colonial era to their countries of origin.

item.title: French lawmakers back bill to end 'marital duty'
item.description: French lawmakers on Wednesday unanimously approved a bill seeking to end "marital duty", after criticism from women's rights groups about its use to ignore sexual consent in marriage and marital rape.

item.title: Paris protesters rally against Trump immigration crackdown
item.description: Dozens of protesters rallied in Paris on Wednesday against US President Donald Trump's immigration crackdown, voicing horror and fear after a second fatal shooting by immigration agents capped months of escalating violence.

item.title: French Senate rejects assisted dying law
item.description: France's Senate upper house on Wednesday rejected a government-backed draft law on assisted dying that had been billed as one of the country's most important society changes in more than a decade.

item.title: PODCAST: Is France becoming less child-friendly and what's at stake in spring's local elections?
item.description: Welcome back to Talking France - this week's podcast covers the latest news on the French elections, banning children in French trains, fun festivals in February and how to pronounce that tricky French 'R'.

item.title: French expression of the day: Je vais me la péter
item.description: It has nothing to do with farting...

item.title: What happened to France's planned driving license exchange fee?
item.description: You may remember that one of the - many - proposals in France's 2026 budget was to charge foreigners a fee to exchange their driving licence for a French one.
